name: AERE@WEAI 2027 - AERE sessions at the 102nd WEAI Annual Conference
organizer: Association of Environmental and Resource Economists (AERE)
conf_dates_note: AERE sessions are organized during 28-30 June 2027
deadline_note: Submissions open 1 October 2026; must be received by 13 November 2026 "for full consideration".
submission_requirements: Abstract max. 500 words (empirical work must describe data and methods); blind review; one submission per presenter (an optional second abstract may be flagged "STANDBY PAPER"); complete session proposals (four papers) and panels welcome; each participant discusses one other paper
membership_required: All paper presenters must be 2027 AERE members (memberships bought on or after 1 Oct apply to the next calendar year); WEAI membership not required but affects the registration fee
